prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

You are reviewing layouts of one table, all rendered in a real browser with identical content, font, padding and colours; only column widths differ. You do not know who or what produced them. The first image is the content overview (every cell on one line).
Table: Lange deutsche Komposita (language de).
Grid: 3 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "Begriff" · longest unbreakable word 546px · one-line width 546px
  col 2: header "Kurzform" · longest unbreakable word 83px · one-line width 101px
  col 3: header "Erklärung" · longest unbreakable word 186px · one-line width 1091px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
This table cannot fit without splitting words at 720px. You MAY choose a total wider than 719px (the reader then scrolls horizontally), or squeeze and accept splits — a design decision.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Rate EACH layout independently: "excellent" | "good" | "acceptable" | "poor" | "bad", with a short reason that points at what you see. Then name the best layout(s) (ties allowed), say how confident you are (low/medium/high), and note anything you are unsure about.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"ratings":{"A":{"grade":"","why":""},"B":{"grade":"","why":""},"C":{"grade":"","why":""},"D":{"grade":"","why":""},"E":{"grade":"","why":""},"F":{"grade":"","why":""}},"best":["letter"],"confidence":"","unsure":""}

log.raw: {"ratings":{"A":{"grade":"acceptable","why":"Everything fits on screen with a sensible three-way balance and readable row rhythm, but the compound-word column is squeezed to ~305px so it breaks the very terms the table is about mid-morpheme ('...überwachung / saufgabenübertragungsgesetz'), and the explanation column at ~232px wraps into many short lines, making rows tall and the text choppy."},"B":{"grade":"poor","why":"The Begriff column (~555px) keeps every compound intact, which suits the topic, but the Erklärung column is pushed almost entirely outside the 720px box — only fragments ('Gese…', 'Dona…') are visible, so the table's actual content requires horizontal scrolling to read at all."},"C":{"grade":"good","why":"Best compromise: all three columns visible, the explanation column gets the most width of the no-scroll layouts (~245px) and wraps in comfortable phrase-length lines, Kurzform is snug but only breaks at a legitimate hyphen ('Kfz-/Haftpflicht'), and the Begriff column is as wide as the budget allows (~310px) so only the two longest compounds split."},"D":{"grade":"bad","why":"A very wide Begriff column (~530px) leaves most cells half-empty, while the explanation column is clipped off the right edge and unreadable; the wasted white space and hidden content are both unjustified."},"E":{"grade":"poor","why":"Begriff is cut to ~225px, so nearly every compound is shattered into arbitrary fragments ('...gesell / schaft', '...förderung / sgesetz'), which defeats the table's purpose, and Kurzform is tight enough to feel cramped."},"F":{"grade":"acceptable","why":"Explanation column is the most readable of the all-visible layouts (~295px, few lines, no splits), but this is bought by narrowing Begriff to ~290px, which breaks compounds mid-word ('...fahrtsge / sellschaft', '...förderu / ngsgesetz') and leaves those identifiers hard to recognise."}},"best":["C"],"confidence":"medium","unsure":"Exact pixel widths read off the screenshots; whether horizontal scrolling (B/D) is considered acceptable by the publication, which would change how harshly those are judged."}
